+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+class QueryErrorLogsError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def _parse_iso8601(value: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
+        parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+
+
+def query_error_logs(
+    severity: str,
+    start_time: str,
+    end_time: str,
+    field_filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
+    limit: int = 100,
+) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    api_token = os.environ.get("SUMO_LOGIC_ACCESS_ID") or os.environ.get("SUMOLOGIC_ACCESS_ID")
+    api_secret = os.environ.get("SUMO_LOGIC_ACCESS_KEY") or os.environ.get("SUMOLOGIC_ACCESS_KEY")
+    endpoint = os.environ.get("SUMO_LOGIC_ENDPOINT", "https://api.sumologic.com/api/v1/search/jobs")
+
+    if not api_token or not api_secret:
+        raise QueryErrorLogsError("Missing Sumo Logic credentials in SUMO_LOGIC_ACCESS_ID/SUMO_LOGIC_ACCESS_KEY")
+
+    normalized_start = _parse_iso8601(start_time)
+    normalized_end = _parse_iso8601(end_time)
+    filters = field_filters or {}
+
+    query_parts = [f'severity="{severity}"']
+    for key, value in filters.items():
+        query_parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
+
+    query = " | ".join(query_parts)
+    payload = {
+        "query": query,
+        "from": normalized_start,
+        "to": normalized_end,
+        "limit": limit,
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        endpoint,
+        auth=(api_token, api_secret),
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=30,
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
+    )
+    if response.status_code >= 400:
+        raise QueryErrorLogsError(f"Sumo Logic query failed: {response.status_code} {response.text}")
+
+    data = response.json()
+    results = data.get("results", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
+    return results[:limit]
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import argparse
+    import json
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Query recent error logs from Sumo Logic")
+    parser.add_argument("--severity", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--start-time", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--end-time", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--filter", action="append", default=[])
+    parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=100)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    filters: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+    for item in args.filter:
+        if "=" not in item:
+            raise QueryErrorLogsError(f"Invalid filter: {item}")
+        key, value = item.split("=", 1)
+        filters[key] = value
+
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            query_error_logs(
+                severity=args.severity,
+                start_time=args.start_time,
+                end_time=args.end_time,
+                field_filters=filters,
+                limit=args.limit,
+            ),
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+++ /private/var/folders/bf/pt_kfhl16yb4r9vfb588n1fm0000gn/T/vb-staged-355pz9ih/write_structured_log.py
@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+import json
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+import requests
+
+
+DATADOG_URL = os.getenv("DATADOG_LOGS_API_URL", "https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com/api/v2/logs")
+DATADOG_API_KEY = os.getenv("DATADOG_API_KEY")
+
+
+def write_structured_log(message, service=None, level="info", **fields):
+    if not DATADOG_API_KEY:
+        raise ValueError("DATADOG_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload = {
+        "ddsource": "python",
+        "service": service or os.getenv("DD_SERVICE", "app"),
+        "status": level,
+        "message": message,
+        "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+    }
+    payload.update(fields)
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        DATADOG_URL,
+        headers={
+            "DD-API-KEY": DATADOG_API_KEY,
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps([payload]),
+        timeout=10,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return {"status_code": response.status_code, "provider": "datadog"}
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(0)
